name: Hawk Dash
summary: Third likeness pass: wider lower stance, body widening starts lower, sloping shoulders above the wheels, narrower upper cabin, and a rounded nose in plan. Lamps sit closer to the reference shapes and heights; exhaust outlets are closer together. Cheap wheels retained; triangles 2702 / 879 / 597 within 2800 / 900 / 600. New reference-derived tests check local width, shoulder slope, nose taper, lamps/outlets and camera setup at every LOD. Collision hulls and handling retained.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

reference.note: Previous and revised models use the SAME corrected horizontal camera at car midpoint. Shaded views and silhouette diffs now share perspective projection. Front/rear use a long-lens 50 m distance; 3/4 views are horizontal at 0.78 m, instead of the old elevated views. Generated reference sheets are unchanged and are not calibrated photographs. Enlarged FRONT/REAR rows lead each sheet. Weighted IoU at the corrected camera: .9392 → .9486 / .9391 → .9526 / .9412 → .9497. New local likeness tests pass all tiers and reject the previous model; owner likeness judgement is still needed. See validation report for commands and failure-injection evidence.

findings.text: source, contract and reproducibility: bake.txt, reproducibility.txt, contract.txt. Byte-reproducible GLBs, eleven damage parts, existing mass sum/units/anchors and one shared paint material. Frozen colliderPoints and handling retained. Roof height and number mount unchanged.

geometry and budgets: geometry.json audits the shipped GLBs: 2702 / 879 / 597 triangles. Wheels 176 / 112 / 112, body 2526 / 767 / 485. Prior pass totals 2697 / 837 / 553. Initial wheel-heavy baseline was 668 / 152 / 152 wheel triangles. Finite vertices/normals, no zero-area triangles, closed manifold wheel inner walls and ground contact. Three LOD0 louvres/fins and fewer arch stations fund curves; LOD2 now retains coarse arch shoulders.

likeness checks: tools/vehicles/test/likeness.test.mjs runs in the existing vehicle CI directory. Twelve tests include current geometry at EVERY tier, immutable reference/mask hashes, frozen cameras, and deliberate defects: narrow base, early widening, square nose, displaced/missing lamps/outlets and elevated/mismatched cameras. Expected contours come from reference masks and internal cue polygons are annotated in reference pixels; expectations are not copied from model params. See tools/vehicles/fit/likeness.md and refs/likeness.json. Actual previous source fails the new gates: baseline-checks/ receipt. Current browser silhouette contours and projected feature masks pass as recorded in reference-lodN/likeness.json and SVG overlays.

silhouette comparison: corrected-camera weighted IoU .9392 → .9486 (LOD0), .9391 → .9526 (LOD1), .9412 → .9497 (LOD2). Front .9200 → .9392 and rear .9202 → .9417 at LOD0. Side .9618 → .9537 is a small regression; front/rear/top improve and the remaining differences are visible. Approximate .95 target, plus local and visual cue review; no claim of complete likeness. Reference/previous/revised/diff sheets are reference-lodN/sheet.png.

paint, hinges and spec: focused-tests.txt, 54 tests. Bright paint/neutral tyres, sidecar pivots and shared spec handling checked. No renderer batching/material changes; existing instancing benchmark is not remeasured.
physics fit: sim.json, native jj-sim settle and Hawk straight-run fixtures pass with matching deterministic replay. This is a retained-hull check, not a new driving-feel assessment.

visual and damage evidence: views/lods/paints/colliders, paint strip, intact/loose/detached strips, 1/4/24-grid samples. Dark bays retained. Evidence viewer samples do not requalify host number readability, dynamic debris lifetime or an N×N host benchmark; those runtime systems are unchanged.
POC loader/controls; deployed verification: see self-review.md. Engine/audio unchanged; prior broad lab failures remain tracked by br-8h3u.12 and are not recertified here.
